title: HQ never warns when one gym's AI use jumps
what: If a member or staff member keeps the AI busy at one gym, HQ only shows it on that gym's own page. Needs you has no line for it and the gym list cannot be sorted by AI use or cost, so the owner has to open gyms one by one to find who is using the most.
expected: A Needs you line, or a gym list sort, that shows the gyms whose AI use or cost is far above normal.
how_often: only when a gym's AI is overused
fix_line: Add a Needs you line for gyms near their AI daily limit several days running, and a sort by AI cost on the gym list
